{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
print(df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum(), 'duplicate patient_ids')

# Identify the highest sample_seq per patient
# Then keep only the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify the deduplication
df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()"}
